posts.title: Prime Big Deal Days starts tomorrow

posts.body:
Prime Big Deal Days opens at 12:01 AM PDT tomorrow and runs 48 hours, [per Don't Pay Full's run-up guide](https://www.dontpayfull.com/explore/amazon-prime-big-deal-days-deals), with fresh drops at midnight, 8 AM, and 1 PM PDT each day.
The U6 Pro sits at $648, so Tuesday morning's first wave is the one to measure your Best Buy cart against.

posts.title: Constructor builds Stripe checkout into its shopping agents
posts.excerpt: Constructor announced Agentic Checkout today, embedding Stripe payments directly into its onsite AI shopping agents so shoppers can discover and buy inside one conversation, per Unite.AI. The company…
posts.body: Constructor announced Agentic Checkout today, embedding Stripe payments directly into its onsite AI shopping agents so shoppers can discover and buy inside one conversation, [per Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/constructor-embeds-stripe-checkout-in-its-onsite-ai-shopping-agents/). The company says it is the first to offer Stripe-powered checkout inside an onsite shopping agent, and reports the number of companies deploying its AI agents is up 900% over the past year, [per the same write-up](https://www.unite.ai/constructor-embeds-stripe-checkout-in-its-onsite-ai-shopping-agents/).

posts.title: GTA 6 will require firmware 14.10.00, blocking PS5 jailbreak
posts.excerpt: GTA 6's release build will require PS5 firmware 14.10.00.00, per the PlayStation Game Size datamine. Sony's October 1 patch killed the Relapse jailbreak that ran on firmware up to 13.60.
posts.body: GTA 6's release build will require PS5 firmware 14.10.00.00, [per the PlayStation Game Size datamine](https://www.notebookcheck.net/GTA-6-blocks-PS5-jailbreak-and-piracy-on-release-date-requiring-14-10-00-firmware.1414828.0.html). Sony's October 1 patch killed the Relapse jailbreak that ran on firmware up to 13.60.

posts.title: Arrest in 2011 Waterbury cold-case murder
posts.excerpt: Heriberto Colon, 59, was arrested Sept. 8 and charged with murder in the December 13, 2011 stabbing death of Waterbury handyman Jose Domenech, 48, per the case write-up. A second blood profile from…
posts.body: Heriberto Colon, 59, was arrested Sept. 8 and charged with murder in the December 13, 2011 stabbing death of Waterbury handyman Jose Domenech, 48, [per the case write-up](https://ctmissingpeople.substack.com/p/police-make-arrest-in-2011-waterbury). A second blood profile from the maintenance garage sat unmatched for 14 years until a November 2024 firearms conviction forced Colon's DNA into CODIS.

posts.title: Deisseroth, Hegemann and Nagel win 2026 Nobel medicine prize
posts.excerpt: Karl Deisseroth of Stanford, Peter Hegemann of Humboldt University and Georg Nagel of the University of Würzburg won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for their discoveries on…
posts.body: Karl Deisseroth of Stanford, Peter Hegemann of Humboldt University and Georg Nagel of the University of Würzburg won the [2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine](https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/deisseroth-hegemann-nagelwin-2026-nobel-medicine-prize-2026-10-05/) for their discoveries on light-gated ion channels and optogenetics. The technique turns light into a precision switch for individual nerve cells in a living brain, and it is now standard equipment in neuroscience labs worldwide.
